character: Highest village in the Val d'Isère commune at 1,930m. Gets the most snow. Traditional hamlet with its own beginner area and gondola up the Glacier. Quirkier, quieter, more snow-sure. La Daille nearby. Good for early-season.
dining: Mountain restaurants at glacier base. Bar-restaurant village.
shopping: Minimal — bakery, small shop. Main shops in Val.
activities_nearby: Fornet glacier skiing (Glacier du Pisaillas). Snow-sure — best early/late season. Shuttle bus to Val (5 min).
